reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Ampoule 50mL Special Set (+Cream 20mL)
reviews.text: Round Lab favourite that I keep coming back to. Skin feels moisturised without being sticky (the reason that I do not use the toner version of this during the humid summer months). Highly recommended for part of your everyday skin care routine.
reviews.zh: Round Lab 嘅心水產品，會回購。皮膚感覺到保濕又唔會黏笠（所以夏天濕熱嘅月份我就唔會用佢嘅爽膚水版本）。極推薦加入你嘅日常護膚程序。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Ampoule 50mL Special Set (+Cream 20mL)
reviews.text: This serum is lovely. It is a thin consistency. It is light and almost watery but still has some weight to it. It absorbs beautifully into the skin. It works very well with the oningredients barrier cream and it also plays well with certain sake lotions. It doesn't play well with Aestura cream or with PDRN cream. I tend to layer it with another serum and essence as well as toner because my skin tends to require more moisture.
reviews.zh: 呢款精華好正。質地偏稀。感覺輕盈近乎水狀但仍然有少許厚度。皮膚吸收得好靚。配搭 oningredients 屏障霜好好用，配某啲清酒乳液亦夾得嚟。但就同 Aestura 乳霜或者 PDRN 乳霜夾唔到。我通常會再疊加另一支精華同乳液加爽膚水一齊用，因為我皮膚需要多啲保濕。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Ampoule 50mL Special Set (+Cream 20mL)
reviews.text: Great all-year-round ampoule to use after either Round Lab's Silver Birch or Dokdo toners. Not at all sticky, leaves even dry-feeling skin quenched and can be used before applying a serum. Have been using this daily, since coming across it 2 years ago. I wish OY would bring back the 2 for 1 offer on this one!
reviews.zh: 好好用嘅全年適用安瓶，配合 Round Lab 嘅白樺爽膚水或者 Dokdo 爽膚水之後用。完全唔黏笠，連感覺乾燥嘅皮膚都用完都水潤，可以喺搽精華之前用。自從兩年前發現之後每日都用。希望 OY 會再出呢款嘅買二送一優惠！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Ampoule 50mL Special Set (+Cream 20mL)
reviews.text: Very moisturising and gives the glass skin effect. Have been using with the Birch Tree collection with the toner and moisturiser and after using it for several days people have noticed my skin has changed to look more smooth and bright.
reviews.zh: 非常保濕，有玻璃肌效果。一直同白樺系列嘅爽膚水同保濕霜一齊用，用咗幾日之後，身邊朋友都留意到我塊面變得更滑更亮。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Ampoule 50mL Special Set (+Cream 20mL)
reviews.text:
美容液というより化粧水に近い。ほんとうにとろみのないサラサラとした水という感じで、なぜ美容液にしたのか若干謎。保湿力も低く、水分チャージはできるが閉じてくれる感じはしないのでこれ一つだと物足りないかなという感じ。
もともと朝のメイク前の美容液として水分セラムを探してましたが、これはちょっと水すぎて微妙でした。
刺激がないのとしんとうするかんじがあるのはよかったです。
reviews.zh:
比起精華，反而更接近爽膚水。真正係毫無黏稠感、爽爽哋嘅水狀，點會當佢係精華有少少費解。保濕力都偏低，可以做到補水但就冇封鎖感，所以單靠呢支會覺得唔夠。
本來想搵一支朝早化妝前用嘅補水精華，但呢支太水，效果一般。
冇刺激同滲透感覺算係好嘅地方。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Ampoule 50mL Special Set (+Cream 20mL)
reviews.text: I’ve been using this for months after trying various products. This hits the spot and quickly became my favorite roundlab ampoule. It absorbs really quickly and really makes me feel like I’m getting moisture in my skin.
reviews.zh: 我試過唔同產品之後，已經用咗呢支幾個月。佢啱晒我需要，好快就成為我最鍾意嘅 roundlab 安瓶。吸收速度好快，真係畀到我塊面有飲到水嘅感覺。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Ampoule 50mL Special Set (+Cream 20mL)
reviews.text: The Birch Juice Ampoule is an amazing part of my skincare routine. It has a light liquid texture and absorbs quickly into the skin, delivering a nice boost of hydration. It layers well with other hydrating products/ moisturizers. Leaves me with glowy, firm skin.
reviews.zh: Birch Juice Ampoule 係我護膚程序入面不可或缺嘅一部分。質地輕盈似水，吸收得快，可以畀肌膚補充水分。與其他保濕產品或面霜疊用都唔會打架。用完之後皮膚水潤有光澤，仲有彈性。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Ampoule 50mL Special Set (+Cream 20mL)
reviews.text: This anti-ageing hydrating ampule is great for smoothing fine lines & plumping the skin. You can layer the product for more moisture & plumping effect. It can be applied with a few drops all over the skin, soaked on a cotton pad on the skin for 5-10mins or added to your moisturising cream.
reviews.zh: 呢支抗老保濕安瓶用嚟撫平細紋同令皮膚飽滿效果一流。可以疊搽增加保濕同飽滿效果。可以用幾滴全面塗抹，或者浸濕化妝棉敷喺皮膚上 5-10 分鐘，亦可以加入保濕霜一齊用。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
